cases.name: deferred_inline_plate_shake
cases.source: protocol T(flag=true) {let mode="vortex"; if flag {mode="shake";} agit(sample=plate(format="96well"),mode=mode,duration=1min);} T();

cases.name: unused_dynamic_label
